title: Expanding the Low-Income Financial Assistance Programs / City's Utility Services Bill / Effective Assistance Program
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City CouncilREQUEST the Department of Water and Power, in coordination with the Office of the City Attorney and the Office of Finance, to provide a report in 60 assistance programs in regard to days analyzing the feasibility of expanding the low-income financial the City's utility services bill. The feasibility report should recommend ways to increase the capacity of the number of participating households and/or identify ways to increase available funding to provide greater assistance to low-income families. I FURTHER MOVE that this feasibility analysis includes coordination with the Office of Finance in consideration of its role as the administrator of the Lifeline Rate Application Program. PRESENTED BY: Adrin NAZARIAN Councilmenter, Ngr 2nd District G 9b SECONDED BY: Mumuh OCT 30 2026
